mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue and profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three-month RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of four-month INDPRO above 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in CPI inflation above 3% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL < 103 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of simultaneous FEDFUNDS rise and CPI < 103 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force participation rate (implied by PAYEMS and UNRATE) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals broader labor supply, which increases aggregate demand and supports higher earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of three-month labor force expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue and profit expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of four-month RSAFS above 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three-month INDPRO below 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).
